data_description.tls_fingerprint: HTTPS only. Overrides certificate verification. Clear this field to restore the Verify TLS certificate setting. A changed certificate requires a newly verified fingerprint.
data_description.track_wifi_clients: Read-only WLAN and LAN device discovery during slow polling. Enable wanted trackers under Settings > Devices & services > Entities, including disabled entities.
data_description.client_consider_home: Confirmed absence before reporting a client away (0-3600 seconds). Errors and polling pauses reset the grace period.
data_description.sms_event_content: Off by default. If enabled, the event contains sensitive data that Home Assistant may record.
data_description.sms_legacy_preview: Off by default. Restores the previous state and attributes for existing automations. The number and text are visible in the entity and may be recorded.
